component.name: Notepad
component.summary: Write and edit text and Markdown files

description.p: Notepad is a fast, simple text editor with tabs. It opens and saves plain text files exactly as they are, in UTF-8, UTF-16 or Windows-1252, with Unix or Windows line endings.
Markdown files can show their formatting as you write: headings, bold and italic text, lists, checklists, quotes and links, with a toolbar to add them. The file itself stays plain Markdown.
Your tabs, unsaved changes included, come back the next time you open Notepad. It collects nothing and needs no account.
